title: Optimization of a SnO2-based electron transport layer using cerium oxide for efficient and stable perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00296F, Paper
Zhipeng Liu, Zhiwei Gu, Yang Lv, Zhiqin Su, Jian Sun, Linlin Qiu, Pingfan Du
The introduction of CeOx together with SnO2 results in a dual electron transport layer, which improves the morphology of SnO2 films, modulates the energy level arrangement and thus improves the device performance.
